cases.observed: Homepage includes clinical dose, improved absorption, testosterone/cortisol, consumer results and third-party tested claims as merchant-written marketing text.
cases.risk: Supplement/health claims may be unsubstantiated and cannot become default reusable theme or generated merchant copy.
cases.vsn_guard: Require seller-vetted compliant product claims, availability of supporting documents, local laws/markets and neutral field placeholders; never hardcode physiological benefits.

cases.observed: Four-question personalized wellness quiz plus a bundle builder with variant/selling-plan JSON and headline discount tiers in publicly readable HTML.
cases.risk: Marketing tier labels and suggestion logic cannot establish eligibility, prices, privacy consent or a completed add-to-cart; inline sensitive questionnaires may need privacy review.
cases.vsn_guard: Use merchant-configured, privacy-conscious optional quiz rules; validate real selling plans and native discounts on selected eligible variants, no fabricated financial savings.

cases.observed: Collection displays Advanced filter 3/4 placeholder group names with no values, and some products say Register to see prices.
cases.risk: An indexed label without underlying field values may be unconfigured example; restricted price data could leak via client JSON unless buyer entitlement is enforced server-side.
cases.vsn_guard: Hide empty filters; honor Shopify/Plus B2B customer eligibility and market-specific price rules before emitting product price data in HTML/Ajax/API.

cases.observed: Jewellery sourcing page references several apparently unrelated named brands, unverified GIA/RJC/carbon-neutral claims and differing old target dates.
cases.risk: Demo sustainability and certifications appear to reuse example text; cannot assert merchant authenticity or legal compliance.
cases.vsn_guard: Only display verified merchant claims with evidence/source and market/dated scope, require editorial copy QA and nonduplicated brand names.

cases.observed: Sixteen products, Compare checkbox controls, in-stock counts, color/size facets; PDP also last crawled around 1.1 years ago.
cases.risk: Old indexed quantities do not prove current stock/variant behavior or Theme Store permission for an app-like compare UI.
cases.vsn_guard: Use live variant/market inventory data; optional VSN comparison app remains separate from Theme Store release; test actual cart/compare only when rendered session accessible.

cases.observed: EUR price and multiple region options coexist with '$300' shipping threshold copy and zeroed campaign countdown placeholder.
cases.risk: Promotional thresholds and time-based promises can be misleading across markets if merchant copy is not policy-linked.
cases.vsn_guard: Determine currency/region-qualified free-shipping threshold from the same Shopify policy source and real event deadline; zero/expired timer should hide or show approved ended state.
